description: Land Title Settlement Department - Amendment to the Gaz. Ex. No. 1905/46 of 13.03.2015 and other amendments
reasoning: This gazette content exclusively deals with amendments to land title registrations under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains specific details about parcels of land, including their numbers, block numbers, cadastral maps, locations, and amendments to land title particulars. The content is purely land and property-related, falling squarely within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) which covers land registrations, title amendments, and property matters.
